verdicts.strengths: The iter1 blocker is fixed. The ship is moored broadside off the front rim and the basin is gone, so Southperry now reads as the island's port in Region_SouthperryAndSplitRoad, Island_Hero and Island_WorldMapStyle. All the classic landmarks are present and readable in the Overview: the west domed house with Paul on its balcony, the 2.5 m cliff with rope davits and coils, the sunken street with the blue-gabled Armor Store and its in00 threshold, Biggs's gazebo on the dressed belvedere (blue-shuttered wall windows, an arch, ladders), the grand white staircase, and a three-masted ship whose sails are now cream rather than slate. The houses read white against the sandstone. The harbour quarter and the belvedere back row replace iter1's blank mesa and basin with a convincing Santorini-like hillside. The A Split Road trail runs cleanly into the pale ArrivalRoad beside west00 at the back-left corner. The magenta Main route can be traced west00 → road → WestStair → street → ramp → grand stair → quay → gangplank → deck. All 26 routes pass in both directions. It is the most distinctive map on the island. Every wave-1 claim checks out in the renders: the ship re-moor, lighthouse, arrival road, belvedere, annex, quay booths, rope davits, sails and fountain.

The retheme is visible and the room no longer reads as a copy of the 1010001 Weapon Store, despite sharing its shell. It has cream flag tiles with a blue band, an off-centre rope-bordered compass rug, a lobster-pot and fishing-net corner by the door, a ship's wheel and lifebuoy, an arched sea window with a light shaft, and a cargo net under the beam. The single KnightArmor is now joined by varied goods (chainmail stand, tabard mannequin, glove rack, helmet piles). The whitewashed entry step with the player on it is in place. Pan reads clearly in his blue-and-white booth window. The frame fill went from about 40% to about 75%. The ware heap is real geometry, and traversal passes on Main, WareHeap, TopShelf, Rafters and Rope.

issues.issue: The ship's sails hide the boarding point, which is the reason this map exists. Because the ship is moored broadside on the camera (-y) side of the quay, the set fore and main topsails, the topgallants and the big jib sit between the camera and the quay's front strip (local y 3-8, x 63-82). That strip holds the last segment of the Main route, the gangplank at x≈74.1, the ticket booth (68.4, 6.2), the cargo derrick (65.2, 5.2) and Shanks (71.9, 5.4). In iter2 Southperry_60000_Gameplay, Shanks is entirely behind the main topsail (his debug beacon shows only as a yellow fleck between the sails), and the gangplank is only a sliver between masts. The Gameplay camera (GAMEPLAY_FOCUS (60,16), scale 54) makes this worse. The ship's deck is cut off by the bottom edge of the frame, the 25 m lighthouse fills the right fifth, and the upper half is mostly empty paving.
issues.fix: In the ship asset's sail spec loop (around m60000_Southperry.py line 841), also furl k==1, the fore and main topsails, onto their yards with _furled_sail, as the courses already are. Keep the topgallants (k==2), the mizzen and only the upper jib for the silhouette, or drop the lower jib. A moored ship with furled sails is also more believable. At this camera angle the topgallants project well behind the quay front strip, so the strip clears. Then retarget GAMEPLAY_FOCUS to about (64, 9) at scale about 50, so the deck, gangplank, ticket booth, Shanks and the grand stair foot are all in frame. Optionally move Shanks to the quay at the gangplank foot, about (72.5, 6.4), facing the camera, so he is the first thing seen when climbing the grand stair. Re-render Gameplay and check that Shanks and the gangplank are unobstructed.

issues.issue: The lighthouse is about 25 m tall, with a top around 31 m local, and is stretched vertically: scale (1.15, 1.15, 1.32) at LH = (79.6, 6.6). The triage set 16-20 m and explicitly rejected 22-26 m as too tall beside two-storey houses. The stretch makes the dome onion-shaped, which the author admits. In the Gameplay frame the tower is a pillar covering x 1380-1600 at full height, and it hides the lower DomeTower of the harbour quarter. Island shots are near top-down, so the extra height adds almost nothing there.
issues.fix: Change line 1222 to a uniform scale=(1.15, 1.15, 1.15), about 19-20 m, which also restores the dome's proportions. Keep the position. It is still taller than the masts (~17 m) and remains the vertical landmark of the south rim. If footprint clearance allows, a uniform 1.2 is also acceptable.

issues.issue: The Overview camera crops Southperry's signature landmark. mapkit.MapCtx.cameras() fits the Overview only to the map footprint (0..L × 0..D × z). The ship deliberately overhangs the front rim (hull at local y ≈ -7.8..-0.8, bowsprit tip around x 90), so in renders/iter2/Southperry_60000_Overview.png the hull is cut off by the bottom edge of the frame. The canonical screenshot of the port loses its ship. Any other map with overhanging landmarks would have the same problem.
issues.fix: In mapkit.cameras(), for exterior maps, merge the footprint points with _built_bbox_points((col_terrain, col_arch, props)) clipped to the footprint plus about 12 m. Alternatively, support an optional module-level OVERVIEW_EXTRA = [(x0,y0,x1,y1)] bounding box, and set it in m60000 to (60, -9, 92, 0). Re-render Southperry_60000_Overview and confirm the whole hull and bowsprit are in frame.

issues.issue: The hovering-ship idea doesn't come across. The triage specified a ship hovering on barrel engines, which is fine, but only one barrel shows, at the stern. In the Overview and Region shots the lower hull is seen against the dark-brown cliff face, so the ship reads as stuck to the cliff rather than floating off the island. No water or air is visible under it to sell the docking.
issues.fix: Make the engines readable at overview scale. Add a barrel-engine pod with a propeller or vent on each quarter, plus one forward under the bow, on the port (camera) side of the hull. Add two or three small cloud puffs or a soft wake ring under the keel (reuse the existing cloud asset, scaled 0.3-0.5, at about ship_z - 1.5). Reuse instances only: the map is at 364k of its 400k triangle budget.

issues.issue: 60001 contributes 9 of the 35 props_near_routes items behind the only failing validator check. Only one of them is a real gameplay concern: the two Eave_Lashed_4m at (4.3, 11.4) and (8.3, 11.4) have solid geometry 0.23 m from the Rafters loft route centreline at body height, so a player walking the beam would clip them. The rest are deliberate goods on the climbable heap: X60001_HelmetPile at (14.1, 4.0), (14.1, 8.1), (12.2, 9.2) and (13.6, 11.0), X60001_ShieldBarrel (13.3, 4.0), Barrel (13.4, 5.2), and Crate (12.9, 11.1), each 0.6-1.35 m from the WareHeap or TopShelf routes.
issues.fix: Move the two Eave_Lashed_4m at least 0.6 m off the Rafters centreline, toward the back wall (+y), or raise them above head height (more than 1.8 m over the beam top). Either nudge the helmet piles and barrels to at least 1.5 m from the WareHeap and TopShelf centrelines, or, if the shared validator supports it, tag them as passable small decor so the heap keeps its cluttered look. No other work is needed on this interior.

issues.issue: The right third of Southperry_60000_Overview and the right half of Region_SouthperryAndSplitRoad, the island ground east and north-east of the quay, is a flat, bright lawn with a few round trees. It is the emptiest area in the region and does nothing to suggest a coast next to the port.
issues.fix: In world filler, give the rim strip east of 60000's footprint a coastal treatment: a palm grove, a few beach-sand patches and rock outcrops. That ties the whitewashed port to its shore and fills the dead quarter of the frame. This is world-level work, not inside the map's footprint.

verdicts.strengths: All four claimed wave-1 fixes show in the iter2 renders. The stone flights now have five chunky steps each, with a rock and a flower tuft at each side and no grass band across them. One continuous dirt trail runs from the spawn under Heena's bush, down the three-step descent, to out00. The laundry lines now use Y-shaped posts with a white sheet, and a butterfly sits on a post. BluffLadder is merged into one route. The orange spotted house, the barrels by the door, Heena on her bush, the mushroom row at the ladder foot, and the laundry bluff with Sera all read in one glance. The hill skirt has replaced iter1's terraced pancake. This is the strongest 'first screen' in the region.

Every triage item landed and shows in the renders. The big YellowStreaked house, with its barrel chimney, stands right beside Roger's hedge-faced garden, which has the blue-rope vegetable fence, crop rows, a scarecrow and Roger visible over the hedge. The invented orange and blue houses are gone, replaced by Roger's tool shed and a well. The door path now reaches the door, with the barrel and crate beside it. A dense sunflower bed with butterflies at the arrival point gives the map a colour signature. A mailbox, lamps, benches and planters line the street. The map no longer looks like a copy of 20000.

The west flights whose risers faced away from the camera, and their lamps and fences, are gone. The new double flight climbs the camera-facing south faces and reads as stairs, with the dirt trail running under and over each flight. The v1 blue house is removed and BlueCone is enlarged. All the classic beats are present: Nina on the mossy giant stump, the sky islet as a giant red mushroom cap with a ladder, the orange house with the in01 door, and the stone oven tower with its log pile and out00 at its little door. SkyIslet is now one route.

The cap seam is fixed: the cap now reads as one smooth arch, which I checked in a 3x crop. A blue and teal quilt, blue and green rugs, cool-coloured jars and a teal armchair reading corner break up the all-orange room. A coat rack and a shoe bench fill the entry nook. The room now fills about 70% of the frame instead of about 40%. Everything the brief asks for is there: the west-wall door with a threshold glow, the lintel, the cupboard, Sen, the ladder to the loft (with a gap in the railing at its top), the bed, the chest, the window and the stove. Traversal passes.

You can now trace the climb. Dirt trail ribbons follow the whole switchback. E1 and E2 are grey rock shelves, distinct from the brown massif. E3 and M1 are separate organic ledges joined by plank walks. Arrow signs mark the switchbacks. Giant red and orange mushroom caps form the U2/U3 stepping stones, which feels very MapleStory. The yellow house with its dormer, the pale stalk clusters at the bottom and the summit, the rainbow fountain, the log bench and Peter at out00 are all present. The shared stone flight down to 40000 makes a strong exit. Main is one route with 3 climbs and passes in both directions.

issues.issue: Mushroom Town does not read as a town at region or island scale (this answers wave-1 shared request #5). In Island_Hero, Island_Overview_Close and Island_WorldMapStyle the town is 4-5 small coloured caps spread over roughly 150 m: orange in 0, yellow in 10000, orange plus blue cone in 20000, yellow in 30000. Each map sits on its own hill plinth with a cliff ring, separated by skirt valleys, the filler forest and pale causeways. In Region_MushroomTownArea, maps 0, 10000 and 20000 look like three separate farmsteads. The classic world map (worldmap_1_spots_annotated.png) draws Mushroom Town as one tight cluster of four roofs (blue cone, yellow, orange, brown) on a single green knoll. Amherst and Southperry read as towns; Mushroom Town reads as fields with a few houses.
issues.fix: This needs a shared decision; pick one. (a) World/layout: give the town maps 0, 10000 and 20000 one shared plinth, with no cliff ring, skirt valley, filler trees or R2-12 shrub ring along their shared edges. The causeways then become short at-grade village streets and the village reads as one hilltop. Whether this fits depends on the per-map plinth and shrub-ring model in layout.py and world.py (R2-6, R2-12), which I could not check from the renders. (b) Map-level, cheaper: reverse the triage's 'no more houses' rule for 10000 and 20000 only. Cluster 1-2 neighbour mushroom houses across the 10000/20000 boundary so the yellow, orange and blue-cone roofs group the way the world map does. For example: a brown or grey-capped house at the east end of 10000's HouseLot, about (39, 31), replacing Veg_Garden_Bed (37.6, 31); and a small yellow or brown house, scale about 0.8, in the north-west back corner of 20000's west lawn, about (3.5, 31.5), clear of Nina's stump. With either option, scale the four landmark caps up about 1.15-1.25x so they read from the island cameras.

issues.issue: Sen's house has the only enterable door in the region, but it does not read as a door. The cap rim of House_Mushroom_OrangeOven hangs down to the top of the door, so the X20000_StoneArch at (30.5, 24.6) shows only as two stone pillars. The arch and keystone are buried inside the cap (Gameplay about 1340-1500 x 280-520, checked in a 2x crop). The in01 threshold glow is a barely visible sliver. The brief names the stone archway with a plank door (classic objects door/8 and door/10, drawn in front of the house) as a key recognition beat.
issues.fix: Move the arch about 0.8-1.0 m further out along the door axis and scale it up so it stands as a freestanding porch arch whose keystone clears the cap rim: change ax, ay = _door_xy(hx, hy, hrot, 2.35) to a distance of about 3.2, and scale 1.15 to about 1.3. Extend Door_Path and move in01 to match. Keep the arch pillars at least 0.9 m either side of the ToSensHouse route; the props_near_routes warning on the arch is expected for a doorway. Do not make the house taller: the classic sprite is squat too. Shared side note: make door-portal threshold glows taller or brighter. They are far harder to see than the edge-portal beams, which hurts the only interior entry on this stretch.

issues.issue: The south verge of the Street terrace (x 12-42, y 3-12, below Street_Path at y≈14) is about a third of the map. It is a flat, nearly empty lawn holding only 4 Flower_Bed_Large, 5 Clover_Patch, 3 bushes, a sign and the fence. In the Overview (about 600-1350 x 680-1000) and the Region shot it is the largest element of 10000, and it makes the 'village green' look like a paddock. The brief asks for a low flowered verge with the meadow below it.
issues.fix: Option A: pull the Street terrace's south edge in to y≈8 (outline points (12,3),(26,2.5),(42.5,4) become about (12.5,8),(26,7.5),(42.5,8.5)). Below it, add a 0.6 m-lower flowered bank (m.terrace 'Verge', top=0.6) carrying the fence, flower beds and a few Hedge_Wall_4m runs, so the front reads as a stepped bank instead of a plane. Option B: keep the footprint and furnish it as the village common: a second sunflower bed at about (16-24, 5-9) echoing the arrival meadow, a picnic table, a notice board, and 2-3 Tree_Round_C at about (20,4), (33,5) and (40,7). Keep everything at least 1.5 m from the Main route at y≈14.

issues.issue: The rope pitches still do not dominate, so triage #3 has only partly landed. In the Overview (crop around 1050-1250 x 780-1000), the hemp ropes Rope_G5_E1 (x 35.4) and Rope_E1_E2 (x 34.2) hang in notches at the west end of the shaded south faces of the grey E1/E2 pillars, right on the left silhouette edge. Grass overhang, a sign and a mushroom cluster partly hide them. They read as two small wooden gallows (the beams) with short beige posts. The 'climb the ropes on the east cliff' beat, which the brief calls the map's identity, is now the least visible part of the climb, while the plank walks and ribbons read strongly.
issues.fix: Move each notch and rope toward the east end of the south face, or onto the larger lit east face, so the rope hangs down the face the camera sees best. For example: E1 notch at x≈37-38 instead of 34.6-36.2, and E2 similarly. Check that the valley floor and E1 cap stay walkable in front of each rope, update the m.ladder x/y/facing, and re-run Main. In _rope_visual: about 1.5x strand radius, a lighter hemp colour against the grey rock, fewer and larger knots (this fixes the 'stacked discs' look), a beam long enough that the rope clears the lip by about 0.4 m, and a rope coil or small pennant on the beam top so each pitch reads at Overview scale. Move the Mushroom_Cluster_A 'climb here' marker so it does not cover the rope foot.

issues.issue: The Main route runs from in00 at (1, 14) south-east down to the front edge at (23, 1.3), then back north up both flights to the street at y 16.6. That is about 40 m of walking on a 42 m map, across a mostly empty west lawn of scattered clover (Overview about 450-1000 x 450-800). The front verge (x 13-42, y 0-8) is also bare. The winding path reads fine, but these are the emptiest parts of the region's main town screen.
issues.fix: Optional: add a direct second climb on the camera-facing side, a cobble or grass ramp from the lawn at about (12, 15.5, 0) to the step at about (18.5, 17, 1.0). Ramps read from the south-east camera, unlike the removed west flights. The porch double flight stays as the civic stair. Dress the lawn bend at about (9-13, 6-10) with a flower ring or sunflower bed, and put a picnic bench under a tree at about (6, 6).

issues.issue: At every inter-map junction in the region (0→10000, 10000→20000, 20000→30000), the pale-sand trails.py causeway ends in a square-cut slab at the portal ring, and the brown in-map m.path dirt starts there. The Maple Road main route is pale between maps and brown inside them, with a hard seam at each ring (Region crops; 0 Overview about 1290-1560 x 830-950).
issues.fix: In trails.py, taper the last 2-3 m of the road at each portal end: a rounded end plus a vertex-colour or material blend from road sand to M_Path_Dirt. Alternatively, let maps tag their Main path with the road material. The taper is cheaper and fixes every map at once.

issues.issue: Map 0 sits at the island's north-west edge. Its Overview is framed on the left by a large bare hill-skirt slope (about 0-450 x 300-1000) holding two isolated grey boulders, with sky behind it, so the game's first screen opens onto an empty green slope. The lower-left half of Region_MushroomTownArea is also generic forest plus a bare skirt mound.
issues.fix: In world.py, dress the skirt next to the start and town maps: a few trees or a small grove plus shrub clusters on the west and north-west flank of map 0's skirt, an extension of the R2-12 shrub ring down the slope. Seat the outcrop boulders into the slope, or group them in 2-3s, so they do not look dropped.

issues.issue: In the Gameplay render about 40% of the frame is striated brown cliff faces: the M3 south face, the E3/M1 faces and the summit east face (wave-1 remaining concern). The climb reads as walls between ribbons.
issues.fix: Break up the large faces: more Rock_Cliff_Stone bands, hanging vines along M3's south face (x 0-18, y≈17.4) and the summit's east face, and 1-2 small non-walkable grass tufts or shelf-mushroom brackets on each face as visual rhythm.

issues.issue: Three small polish items. The dark M_Wood_Dark wainscot only shows as isolated, busy-grained patches behind the loft posts and reads as dirt smudges (Gameplay about 550-760 x 470-600 and 1310-1400 x 640-700). The ladder foot is pressed against the crate stack under the loft (Gameplay about 1000-1140 x 700-800). A faint hairline crease remains on the inner cap skin near the apex (Overview about 840-900 x 85-100).
issues.fix: Use a flat, darker plank tint with no vertical grain for the wainscot, and run it continuously along both back walls. Move the crate stack about 0.8 m away from the ladder foot. The apex hairline can wait.

issues.issue: This is still visible and is already covered by wave-1 shared request #3. The top landings of Steps_Verge_T2 and Steps_Porch_T3 show as sloped plank tongues, with the dirt ribbon carving a curved bite out of them (Gameplay about 200-560 x 620-860). Map 0's stone flights show a smaller version of the same thing.
issues.fix: Implement the requested m.path(..., under=stairs) or square-ended ribbons, or have m.stairs trim its top landing to the cap edge (promote 0's _flight_ends fit-edge logic into mapkit as already requested).

verdicts.strengths: Most claimed fixes are visible. The amphitheatre reads: front valley, central terrace, then the high band stepping back. The four-block staircase is now a diagonal of grass-capped blocks with stone treads (StairBlock_1-4, x 25.4-37.2, y 29-34.8) instead of a bridge. The hump is a raised capsule with grass ramps. The red birch, bush pair and flowers fill CentralTerrace. The back-row trees are thinned to the corners, so the high terraces show. The knoll is three oval tiers you can walk around. The 30000 trail arrives down a railed stone flight onto a sand pad, with Robin beside in00. Do NOT 'fix' the shared west half (plateau, basin, knoll) with 40002: that is classic design. One claim is not visibly achieved: the rebuilt 'angular 7-sided' spire still reads as a 3-tier banded drum at both render scales. Remaining gaps: an empty front valley, plank pads on the knoll flights, and the spire.

The most distinctive Snail map. In the gameplay view the Arch Rock is a real stone arch with a see-through opening, and the Λ-over-V silhouette survives. The pillar is now one column with sunk ledges. The pit became water, so the plank bridge has a reason to exist. The summit grove (yellow, orange, red and teal birches) plus Flower_Bed_Large and Sign_Board at the ribbon-stair top read as a reward, because the lake beach behind it keeps filler trees away. The west entrance grove and picket fences match the minimap. The front route (west00, meadow, bridge, mesa foot, east00) is a clear continuous dirt ribbon. Remaining gaps: the brook reads as a fenced rectangular tank, and the many identical grey banded drums keep the arch area busy.

Traversal is fixed (15 routes, both directions). The 40001 copy (pit, bridge, fence) is gone, replaced by the X40002_Hollow_Log field. The knoll now reads as stepped on the west and sheer on the east: a grass_rock face with bedded boulders and scree. The chimney is legible and distinctive from below: two jambs, three ledges, ropes, a ladder, red banners and a sign. The east00 bastion with banner posts and the stone stair down to 50000 make the exit point findable. The map's concept, 'climb the chimney, walk the ridge', still does not read from the camera. The 5-birch grove on T0's front half, plus the forest behind at the same height, hide the whole crest walk and the Red Snail ridge. The claim that the grove 'reads against the sky' is not achieved from this camera. The only painted path also leads to the dead-end east field.

All iter1 triage items are visibly landed. The Y fork reads both in plan and in height: the lower road curves to the front-right and the upper road climbs to the back-right. The junction plaza has a multi-arm Amherst/Southperry signpost, two lamps, a bench, and a timber stair beside Ladder_2095. Both exits read at region scale: the short link to 1000000 and the long railed road to Southperry. The mesa's big yellow birch and the small red object (a mushroom) are restored. The lower road now has a row of birch, teal and orange trees in front of the mesa, plus fences. Maria's flowered platform with ladder and mailbox is clear. The map is distinct from the three Snail grounds. What remains is polish.

issues.issue: The summit ridge, the map's defining feature, is invisible from the camera. Five large birches stand on T0's FRONT half: Tree_Birch_Teal/Green at (32.8,40.6), (36.6,40.1), (40.4,40.9), (44.2,40.3), (47.6,40.8), scale 0.92-1.08. They sit between the camera and the crest walk, Main_7 at y~43, and the Red Snail zones (31-49 x 39-46 and 53-63 x 41-46). In the Overview, the top third of the frame (screen x 750-1550, y 0-500) is one canopy mass merging with the filler forest. The 11 crest teeth at y 45.2-45.9 (r 0.8-1.4, h 0.9-1.8) read as scattered small grey hexagonal pedestals, not a crest line. Only the 4.9 m front wall reads.
issues.fix:
1. Keep at most 2 grove birches on the front half, clustered at x 31-36 (scale ~0.85). Move the other 3 to the back edge between teeth (y ~45, x 38-48), or replace them with 2-3 saplings, so x 37-60 of the crest walk is open to the camera.
2. Turn the teeth into a continuous rim: widen to r 1.6-2.2 at about 6-8 m spacing, and fill the gaps with low grass_rock rim segments 0.8-1.2 m tall along y 45-46.5. This keeps the tops under ~14.5 m while giving a readable back-edge silhouette.
3. Re-render and confirm the Red Snails and the crest walk are visible from x 30 to 63.

issues.issue: The front valley, which carries the main route and is the first hunting field players see, has no trees at all. dress() places every autumn tree at the back corners, at the sides (1,25.5)/(62.5,29.5), or on the mid band. The classic minimap puts these on the valley floor: a yellow white-trunk birch cluster on the west plateau, a yellow tree in the basin, an orange sapling at the knoll's east foot, and a large orange tree framing east00. In the Overview the plateau, basin and east meadow (screen ~350-1500, 520-1000) read as bare lawn with bushes. The map's autumn identity lives only in the filler forest around it.
issues.fix:
Add m.place calls, all at least 1.5 m off Main (y 9-12) and AroundKnoll:
- West plateau: Tree_Birch_Yellow at (1.8,15.2) scale 1.0, (4.2,16.3) scale 0.85 and (9.6,15.6) scale 0.95 (behind Robin at (5,12.8)), plus Tree_Sapling_A at (2.5,5.6).
- Basin: Tree_Birch_Yellow at (19.5,3.8) scale 1.05 (clear of Rock_B at (23,3)).
- Knoll east foot: Tree_Sapling_A at (45.0,3.2).
- East meadow: Tree_Autumn_A or Tree_Birch_Orange at (59.0,7.2) scale 1.3, framing east00 (63,12), with Bush_B at (61.6,8.4). Move Rock_Boulder from (60,7) to (56,4.5).
Check props_near_routes afterwards.

issues.issue: The grass_rock style (geo.py:407 -> M_Rock_Cliff on the same vertical extrusion) renders as cool grey, perfectly regular horizontal bands on straight-sided cylinders. Every rock landmark in the region reads as a corrugated silo or stack of coins: the 40001 arch legs, V stones and pillar; the 40000 spire, four StairBlocks and RockShelf; the 40002 chimney jambs, crest teeth and exit posts; the 50000 trio, T9/T10 face blocks and Maria's platform. They also clash with the warm brown dirt walls beside them. Triage #13 asked for warm grey-brown, irregular, slightly tapered sides with embedded boulders. Only the material swap landed.
issues.fix:
1. Warm and break up M_Rock_Cliff: base around #8a7d6b to #9a8a72. Domain-warp the strata with noise at 2-3 band scales, and add a vertical crack/darkening mask so bands don't line up between adjacent stones.
2. In geo.terrace for style grass_rock: inset the bottom ring 10-20% (taper), or bulge mid-height for r < 2.5 m, and auto-scatter 1-3 Rock_Cliff_Stone instances on camera-facing faces.
3. Re-render the 40001 Gameplay and 40000 Overview to confirm drums read as rock.

issues.issue:
The R2-10 swept hemp rope still reads as a stiff, bent wooden staff or shepherd's crook standing off the cliff, with a knob at the top. Examples in renders:
- 40001 Gameplay: Rope_918 on the T32 knob (screen 240-300, 540-650) and the ropes at (440-490, 410-550), (880-930, 875-990), (1590-1640, 935-1060).
- 40000 Gameplay: Vine_A/Vine_B at (39.5,17.7)/(42.5,17.7) look like lamp posts.
- 50000 Gameplay: ropes on the trio, T9 and T10.
- 40002: the chimney ropes.
These are rope-only maps (40001 has 8 ropes and no ladders), so this repeats across the region.
issues.fix:
In kit ladder(kind='rope'):
- Thin the strand to r ~0.035-0.045 and hang it within 0.1 m of the face it climbs (use face_point).
- Add knot bulges every ~0.45 m and a slight S-sag, and remove the hooked top knob.
- Draw a clear stake plus loop on the cap 0.4 m back from the lip, with the strand visibly draped over the lip.

Re-check 40001 Gameplay.

verdicts.strengths: Much better than iter1. The island now reads as one coherent floating plateau. The lake is sunk and lobed, with sandy banks, in place of the iter1 swimming pool. The waterfall is a two-tier cliff instead of the 'tin can'. The NW and NE massifs are placed along authored ridges, and the NE ridge frames Amherst. Southperry sits on the south rim with its ship hanging over the void. The sea is sky-blue and self-lit, with no navy shadow wedge. Trails are causeways with stone flights and landings instead of brown wedges. Plinths are now hills on skirts instead of rice-paddy stripes. The forest has meadows and groves, the Dangerous Forest reads as a gloomy pine block, and the regional palettes are visible at island scale (dark-green NW, orange/teal birch valley matching the midForest set, autumn east). Southperry is a strong whitewash/blue landmark. Why needs_work rather than good: two explicit island criteria still fail. Only 1 of 3 towns stands out at island scale, and 47-82 m straight runway trails remain in the forest cluster. The pale main road is a dashed line. Several iter1 triage items were not applied (3e long trails, 9a plinth wobble, 9d halos, 8 sea depth), and the clouds regressed to faceted chunks (perf pass). Most remaining fixes are shared and cheap to mid-cost, so one more targeted wave would materially improve the 'classic Maple Island' read.

issues.issue: Mushroom Town reads neither as a town nor as the classic NW 'pocket' at island scale. Its 5 small houses (0 orange, 10000 yellow, 20000 orange + BlueCone + oven tower, 30000 yellow) are spread over about 150 m of terraces. They are swallowed by a dense carpet of identical dark Tree_Round_A/B/C filler (the world.scenery 'mushroom' palette), with large bare M_Hill skirts between the plinths. No peaks surround it: the NW tip ends in open grass and a bald olive dome (Island_Overview ~(200,280); Region_MushroomTownArea). layout.RIDGES[0] produced only 2-3 peaks, behind 30000/40000. Its western points (-28,44) and (12,46) fall outside the island 'inner' polygon, because RIM_MARGIN[0]=9 pulls the hull in to 9 m from map 0, and/or are rejected by the scenery keepout pad (rad*0.7, about 10-17 m on top of the 6 m map keepout). So the defining world-map image (a house cluster in a peak-ringed pocket) and the grassySoil background (golden-green rolling hills, a few big oaks, cumulus) are both missing. Note: one house per map is on-data (triage decision), so this is a world-side framing problem, not a house-count regression.
issues.fix: (a) layout.RIDGES[0]: move the points 30-45 m beyond the back edges of maps 0/10000/20000 and wrap them round the west of map 0, e.g. geo (-55,10), (-45,50), (0,72), (50,62), (95,40), (130,5), radius 16-26, halo as fixed below. In world.island() add a 'pocket' support polygon to the hull points (the same way lake_poly(extra=30) is added) so the hull covers those peaks while RIM_MARGIN[0] still keeps map 0's own west edge tight. Log each rejected ridge point with its reason (outside inner / keepout / occlusion) and confirm the pocket peaks actually place. (b) world.scenery: replace the 'mushroom' palette with a grassySoil treatment within about 60 m of 0/10000/20000/30000. Cut tree density to about 25% of today (spacing of 14 m or more), mostly single big oaks (Tree_Round_A/B at scale 1.6-2.2) in 2-3 groves. Make the rest open meadow with flower and grass-tuft clumps and a warmer golden-green ground tint (a 'meadow_gold' grass variant on Island_Ground/M_Hill there). Scatter on-data decorative giant toadstool and pale stalk-mushroom clusters (classic acc1/grassySoil nature 11/14/25) on the hill skirts so the area reads as mushroom country. (c) Do not invent extra houses outside maps; landmark scale is a map item (see 20000).

issues.issue: The classic pale main road cannot be traced at island scale. M_Main_Road is applied only to the 11 inter-map trail segments (trails.py via LY.MAIN_ROAD). No map module uses it, and m.main_path (the triage #12 helper) was never built. So inside maps the through-route is brown M_Path_Dirt (all Maple Road maps, 1000000, 1020000) or mid-grey cobble (1010000). The 30000->40000 and 40002->50000 links are grey stone flights. In Island_Overview and Island_WorldMapStyle the road is a dashed line of short cream stubs (the 50000->60000 ramp is the only clearly visible stretch), and the route can be followed only through the chain of plates.
issues.fix: Cheapest first: a world-level post-pass after the maps build (in world.trails or build.py). For every map on the main route, take the declared route(s) joining its two main-road edge portals (the LY.MAIN_ROAD anchors plus the build_report routes). Re-material any path-ribbon object whose centreline lies within 1.5 m of that route to M_Main_Road, or lay a 4.5 m M_Main_Road ribbon over it at +0.03 m. Give stone flights on main-road trails cream treads (M_Main_Road) with stone risers. Fallback: add MapCtx.main_path(points, width=4.5) and run a mechanical map wave over 0, 10000, 20000, 30000, 40000, 40001, 40002, 50000, 60000 (west00 to the quay), 1000000 (west00->east00), 1010000 (keep the cobble pattern but warm it toward cream along the street) and 1020000. Acceptance: Island_WorldMapStyle shows one continuous cream line from the NW tip to the fork to Southperry, and from the fork to Amherst and the east fields.

issues.issue: Long straight runway trails remain in the Rainbow Street forest cluster (build_report trails): 1010002 west00 -> 1010004 is 82.1 m (new since 1010004 was re-anchored), 1000000 in05 -> 1000006 is 64.0 m, in04 -> 1000005 is 58.0 m, and in03 -> 1000004 is 47.5 m. Triage #3(e) asked for the 1000005 and 1000006 links to be under about 25 m; that was not done. trails.build_trail lerps p1->p2 in a straight line with fence rails on both sides, so these read as fenced runways down grass trenches (Region_WestAmherstForests x≈760, ≈1150, ≈1860; Region_AmherstArea x≈800, y 70-490). Together with the plinth top rings (rounded_footprint wobble 1.0 m; triage 9a not applied), the forest cluster reads as a city grid of rectangular blocks in every island shot.
issues.fix: (a) layout.LINKS: change bearings and anchors so resolve() keeps every gap at 25 m or less, and log GAPS, failing the build when a gap exceeds 2.5x its authored value (triage 3e). For example: swing 1000005 from bearing 100 to about 115-120 so it sits NW of 1000001 instead of being pushed north by it. Give 1000006 a bearing or anchor that seats it beside 1000005 (west of 1000002) rather than 64 m north. Move 1010004's east00 anchor or bearing so its trail from Townstreet is about 30 m. (b) trails.build_trail: when mid_len > 25 m, sweep a Catmull-Rom path through 1-2 waypoints offset 8-15 m sideways, or following the lowest ground between plinth skirts. Drop the continuous Fence_Wood_Seg rails on grass-flank sections and keep rails only where the side drop exceeds 2 m. Plant tree and shrub clumps along long trails so they read as forest paths, not causeways. (c) world.plinth: raise the rounded_footprint wobble to 3-4 m on edges without portals and vary the margin per side between 3 and 10 m, so the map tables stop reading as rounded rectangles.

issues.issue: The island body reads as a dark slab, not the classic pale, craggy floating rock. materials.mat_underside defines khaki strata (#8E7F5E/#B3A27A/#D2C29A). But it mixes in 55% dirt_dk toward Generated-z, and the visible S/SW faces receive no sun, so it renders as charcoal-grey stripes. The top 18 m is a different, darker M_Dirt_Cliff band (the Island_Ground terrace with style grass_dirt), so a brown band sits over grey stripes. Below -62 m the taper is a smooth planar wedge (lower half of Island_Hero). The tip is at z -250 and SEA_Z is -260, so in Island_Hero the island seems to rest on the sea instead of floating (triage #8 asked for about -420).
issues.fix: Diagnose first: render once with emission 0.3 on M_Rock_Under to separate the lighting problem from the material. Then: (1) use M_Rock_Under (khaki grassySoil-style strata) for the Island_Ground side band as well, by giving world.island's terrace a rock style instead of grass_dirt, so the cliff is one continuous material. (2) In mat_underside, remove or cut the 0.55 dirt_dk mix and add emission of about 0.2-0.3, or add a light-linked fill from camera-left. (3) In world.underside, add vertical facet noise (varying along the ring index, amplitude 6-10 m from level 1 down) so the faces break into crags. Add 8-15 hanging spires (inverted Mountain_Peak_Rocky, 20-60 m long), clustered under the south rim and Southperry. (4) Move SEA_Z to about -420 and the Cloud_SeaLayer z with it.

issues.issue: Regression: the clouds became faceted low-poly chunks. kit/terrain._cloud builds its puffs with subdiv=1 (from the perf pass). At instance scales of 6-30 m, every Cloud_High, Cloud_CliffBase and Cloud_SeaLayer shows angular polygon silhouettes: see the tower cloud at the top right of Island_Overview, and the cliff collar, which reads as grey crumpled-paper or styrofoam rubble along the whole south side. Iter1 clouds were soft. The peak halos are unchanged (3 Cloud_PeakRing puffs at 0.35*rad, scale 2.2) and still read as cotton or snow lumps stuck to the slopes (NE ridge in Region_AmherstArea and Region_RainbowStreet).
issues.fix: In kit/terrain._cloud, use subdiv=2 for all puff spheres, or add a Subsurf level-1 modifier to Cloud_Puff_A/B. They are instanced, so the cost applies to only two meshes. Keep smooth shading. Thin the Cloud_CliffBase collar in world.scenery (skip about 60% of ring points instead of 45%, use larger and flatter puffs, and push z to -110..-170) so it reads as separate soft puffs, not a continuous band. For halos, use 8-10 flattened puffs on a ring at about 0.5*rad + puff radius, only on Mountain_Peak_Rocky, or drop halos entirely.

issues.issue: The waterfall does not feed the lake, and its cliff reads as a freestanding grey box. LY.WATERFALL['top'] is 41.8 m from LAKE['center'], and the lake's near edge in that direction is about 31 m from the centre. The lower sheet starts at ledge_c + 3.6d and runs fwd 3.0, so it ends about 6 m lake-ward of the top, roughly 5-8 m short of the water. The plunge and its mist land on the grass and sand bank (lake crop of Island_Overview; Region_MapleRoad ~(1300,480)). The crescent Waterfall_Cliff is an extruded grey M_Rock_Cliff block with a flat lawn on top, separated from the olive peaks on both sides, so it looks like a concrete wall rather than a gap in the mountains.
issues.fix: In world.lake(), extend the lower sheet's fwd to where the d-ray meets lake_outline, or add a short flat_poly stream at water_z with a foam strip from the sheet's foot to the lake edge. Move the lower Waterfall_Mist ring onto the water. Do not move the lake; it is tuned to 40001's sightline. Make the cliff part of the ridge: place 2-3 Mountain_Peak_Rocky directly flanking and behind the crescent ends. Taper the crescent top (lower toward the ends, with crags instead of a flat lawn). Use the same warm khaki rock as the underside instead of grey.

issues.issue: The filler hills read as procedural. RIDGES[4] (SW rim, asset Mountain_Hill, spacing 26 m on a straight polyline, radius 9-13) renders as a row of about 7 near-identical, evenly spaced green domes along the south rim: Island_Overview x 400-800, y 470-560; the bottom of Region_MapleRoad; the left of Region_SnailHuntingGrounds. Random-fill low peaks (Mountain_Peak_C/Mountain_Hill) appear as bald olive domes that clash with the bright grass: the NW tip, the bottom of Region_MushroomTownArea, and Region_MapleRoad ~(320,440). The hill skirts are large bare, smooth M_Hill sheets, which adds empty-looking area in the region shots.
issues.fix: For the ridges in world.scenery: jitter each point ±12 m perpendicular to the polyline, use radius 6-16, and group them in clusters of 2-3 with gaps. Sink them 30-50% into the ground (base z about -0.4*h) so they read as rolling hills, not domes, and put a tree clump or rocks on about half. Give Mountain_Peak_C and Mountain_Hill the ground's grass material (M_Grass/M_Hill tint) so they stop reading as olive blobs. In world._hill_skirt, scatter cheap instances on the mid ring (grass tufts, flower clumps, small rocks) so the skirts are not bare sheets.

issues.issue: The south rim is an almost straight cliff line about 700 m long. The convex hull plus wobble of 9 m and 3 m at freq 0.02/0.08 is invisible at island scale, and it is backed by a flat 30 m grass strip with no rim features. Southperry's sand and whiteMarble quarter ends abruptly in flat lawn on both sides along the rim, so at island scale the port reads as a beige rectangle on a lawn rather than a coastal town.
issues.fix: In world.island, add a low-frequency wobble (20-30 m at freq about 0.008) everywhere except near RIM_MARGIN maps, giving 2-3 shallow bays and promontories. Dress the tree-free rim strip with rock outcrops and occasional low rim hills (the classic map rings the rim with peaks). Around 60000, extend a sand/beach ground tint and the 'port' palm palette 25-40 m along the rim on each side of the quay so the port blends into the coast.

issues.issue: At island scale the lighthouse (about 25 m) and the ship are tiny: a white pin and a brown sliver at about (1215,700) in Island_Overview, and barely visible in Island_WorldMapStyle. On the classic world map these two are Southperry's icons.
issues.fix: Raise X60000_Lighthouse_Tall to about 32-35 m, keeping the footprint and scaling the dome uniformly so it is not onion-shaped, and give the lantern room a brighter red/blue cap. Scale the moored ship 1.2-1.3x outward from the quay; it hangs over the void, so this costs no route space. Re-check that the Overview keeps the harbour quarter visible.

issues.issue: Amherst looks good at map scale, but at island scale it reads as a small mid-grey plaza with two cap colours, no bigger than the neighbouring fields. The giant tree's canopy hides part of the yard. The classic world map shows Amherst as a cluster of coloured caps on a pale tiled plaza.
issues.fix: Within the footprint: scale the Weapon Store cap and X1010000_RedTower by 1.15-1.25. Tint the plaza flagstones toward the brief's pale blue-grey and tan, away from mid-grey. Trim the giant tree's canopy 10-15%, or lean it east, so the yard caps show from the island and region cameras. Keep the 1.5 m route clearances.

issues.issue: Sen's orange house, the BlueCone and the oven tower are the core of Mushroom Town's world-map silhouette, but they read as dots from the island cameras. The same applies to map 0's orange house and 30000's yellow house. Only 10000's yellow house was scaled up (1.3).
issues.fix: Scale Sen's orange house and the BlueCone to about 1.3-1.4, and ask 0 and 30000 to scale their houses to about 1.2. Re-check the in01 door threshold, the 4.5 m edge-portal corridors and the props_near_routes report afterwards. This pairs with the shared pocket/meadow fix: the houses only pop once the dense filler around them is thinned.

verdicts.strengths: All four claimed fixes show in the renders. The barrel Hill_Door is set into DoorHill_P02's front face at about (10.3, 27.4), with the ladder beside it. The trail now ends on the swirl over open ground; the iter1 mound that blocked it is gone. The east mushroom-cap stair shows its tops (the last cap is about 65% visible, which is acceptable). The small decor mushrooms are gone, so the Shroom and Orange Mushroom proxies (with spawn rings in the debug render) are the only small caps. Identity is strong: three colourful giant-mushroom staircases climb an amphitheatre of terraces, with berry hedges, white birches, the door terrace stepping down to a front lawn, and the top terraces at the back-right. It looks whimsical and clearly different from 1000004 next door. Trail junction: the 26 m in02 trail drops through a cut in the Field's hill skirt and lands straight on the swirl at (6, 29). The junction itself is clean; its weak point is the bare green cut walls (shared issue). No map-level work needed.

The claimed fixes are visible. The door hill with X Hill_Door at (11, ~25.6) sits just west of the swirl and is no longer hidden. The stump arch is now eight separate posts with plank tongues, bowed and decorated with moss and orange fungus, and it reads as the signature hopping path. The cardboard dirt ramps are all gone. The T1 beds, carrot rows, sunflower summit, purple and carrot beds, the fenced basin plot, scarecrow and beehive sell 'kitchen garden', and the map is clearly different from 1000003's mushroom stairs. Traversal passes. Trail junction: the 47.5 m in03 trail runs along the foot of Amherst's hill and enters the courtyard from the back-left. Its last ~8 m pass behind the T1 carrot column, so they are partly hidden, but the swirl and door stay visible and the arrival reads.

All three iter1 items were open and all three are now visible. The jump tower is a spiral of dark-moss brackets winding round a rock spire, with air between them; it reads as a climbable tower and is distinct from 1000001's white trunk. A dark-bark giant tree now rises from the forest floor at the centre. The old slabs are cut into shelves with the ground showing between them, and ferns, logs and extra trees fill in. The identity points are all there: the door mound on the central knoll, with its ladder and a rope into the tower base; the rainbow fountain front-centre; log piles on the east shelves; and the summit loop along the back. Trail junction: the in04 trail arrives straight at the swirl beside the door mound on the front edge. It is clean, but the trail is very long (shared layout issue).

The biggest identity gap from iter1 is fixed. The dell is now golden-olive with leaf-litter drifts under fresh-green island caps, so it reads as sky islands over an autumn valley in both the overview and the region shot, where it is the most distinctive map in the region. The umbrella leaf is back on T4. The lilies now read as upright stems with bells instead of white birds, and the daffodils show on the summit and T3. The stalks are thinner, with root-ball tiers and hanging roots, and the paddock double fence with its gate is present (small). Trail junction: the 64 m in05 causeway climbs 9.2 m and runs straight into the hub's front lip. Its solid grass flanks fill the space under the hub, so the 'floating arrival' does not read (top issue).

issues.issue: The arrival hub does not float. The 64 m in05 causeway (trails.py, solid sloped grass flanks) runs straight into Hub_T17's front lip; the hub outline already overhangs to y -1.0 and the portal is at (14, 1, 7). A dark-green embankment wedge fills the space under the hub (Gameplay x 420-1000, y 680-1080) and hides the hub's tiered root-ball and the 7 m drop to the dell. The brief's first identity point ('you arrive on a floating island with a door in a grass block, high above an autumn valley') is lost: the hub reads as the end of a ridge.
issues.fix: trails.py: add a bridge ending for arrivals that stand 3 m or more above the ground under the trail end, or use an explicit per-anchor table in layout.py, e.g. BRIDGE_END = {(1000006, 'out00'): 8.0}. Stop the causeway and its flanks about 8 m before the portal. Span the rest with planks on rope rails (same kit as m.bridge, width about 3.0 m) with nothing underneath, and keep the Sign_Arrow on the causeway end. Map side (m1000006): pull the hub outline's overhanging front points (7.6,-0.8), (13.0,-1.0) and (19.0,-0.9) back to y ~0.3 so the bridge lands on a clean lip, and keep routes HubEast/HubToT14 starting at (14, 1). Re-render the Gameplay shot: the root-ball tiers and the golden dell should show under the bridge.

issues.issue: The 'middle of the forest' giant tree does not read as giant. X1000005_Giant_Tree's crown (Overview x 890-1140, y 360-500) is barely bigger than the kit trees around it. Its straight, untapered dark trunk stands in a narrow slot between shelves, so it reads as a chimney with a normal crown on top. Next to it, the T19/T16 log-pile shelves (Overview x 1000-1270, y 640-840) are sheer ~5 m square earth pillars rather than branch platforms on the trunk's east flank.
issues.fix: Widen the crown 1.6-1.8x toward -y and +-x (the camera side), not +y, so the summit loop is not hidden. Keep the crown base at least 10.8 m over T8 and at least 13.7 m over T3/T4 (12.06 + 1.65 clearance). Taper the trunk from about r 2.0 at the base to about r 1.4 under the crown, and spread the root flare about 1.5 m onto the floor round (21.5, 24). Add 2-3 thick limbs from the trunk that pass under T16 and the T8 shelf, so those shelves read as resting on branches. issues.issue: The hill skirt and plinth around the south gardens are large, bare, untextured lime areas. This is the biggest change in the region. (1) Dark blue-green moss caps and wet soil. (2) Gloomy pines plus rust, ochre and teal birches, dead trees, brambles, purple toadstools and bones. One medium map fix would materially improve route reading: the visible trail ends at the east map edge, and nothing leads to the vine climb. verdicts.strengths: All iter1 fixes are visible in the integrated renders. The in01 blocker is gone: the orange house was deleted, and a leafy GardenArch on a raised yard now looks straight up the lane at Townstreet's orange house. The street is one continuous cobble ribbon over gentle ramps, with no floating tiles. The belvedere drums are now a timber lookout with a red-spotted roof and a pennant. The red tower now reads as a mushroom tower (smooth red cap with white spots, periscope chimney), and the yellow house has a smooth cap and a green door. The Weapon Store has a sword/star sign and a thatched annex. The rainbow spring is bigger, and the square has planters and benches. Pio's veg plot is in place, and the giant tree has orange pods. Every brief identity item is present: three cobble levels, plateau reachable only by rope+ladder, five houses with distinct caps, mailbox at the west gate, cut-out boards and banner at the east end. Debug routes are clean. Only small polish remains.

The module is unchanged and still the strongest interior: it reads as a forge workshop (domed furnace with green tank, gear window, chained armor alcove, Sid's booth in the back-left, switchback metal stair to the ceiling beam). Shared waves improved the integrated render: the camera now fills the frame, and the door portal is a flat threshold glow instead of the 'snowman'. Nothing here needs another wave.

The Main route blocker is fixed. The west door is widened into a stone arch with an orange keystone and a fanlight, with a walkable stone doorstep. The cap's cut face now has an apricot rim band and a fan of gill grooves, so it reads as a mushroom slice rather than a projector screen. The garden is built: a leafy TrailArch with the DANGER skull sign at west00, hedges and marigolds along the path, and a back garden with laundry line, woodpile, veg bed and crates. The two-storey cutaway (bookcase downstairs, bed and chest up the ladder) matches the brief. This orange house is the one seen up the lane from Amherst.

The spiral jar shelf now has solid dark risers under pale treads, a collar at the pole, an outer blue rail and a glowing jar on each tread, so the climb order reads. The hidden collision proxies are replaced by real walkable geometry. The identity items are all present: WELCOME booth with money-bag panel, POTIONS shelf, chest shelf, walkable crossbeam, 'Thank you' door. The plaster and half-timber shell sets it apart from the stone Weapon Store while keeping the paired roof beams. The camera now fills the frame.

The arrival now sits on the high rim road (bench and welcome board) and looks down into the valley, which matches the brief's core image. The four climbable vines are bright lime and flowering, and each starts in a fence gap under a flowering Vine_Arch. The decorative curtain has been cut to a few short dark strands, so the climbables are obvious. The bowl is now a stepped U (floor 0.3, bank 1.2, rim 2.1) with a dirt trail. The purple, clover and orange shelf meadows, the orange centre knoll and the east stair are all legible. In debug the route reads clearly: rim, vines, shelf, knolls, bowl, stair back up.

The giant orange mushrooms are now landmark-scale at the end of the ground chain, with the log pile beside them. The plank hops are solid grass earth ramps, and path ribbons no longer stripe over lips. The Tomato Field entrance is a hedge-tunnel nook with the DANGER sign and tomato plants, and the giant tomato appears only on the Tomato Field side. The lattice reads as a terraced hill climbing away from the camera, with earth pillars and ladders. The remaining problems are shared kit and trail issues (ropes, ramp shading, trail end, hidden lane), not module work.

This is the most distinctive field in the region. Tomato rows run into depth in the sunken beds, a trellis pergola canopy is reached by vine-wrapped poles, and there are a giant tomato gate, scarecrows, tomato crates and straw haystacks (no longer yellow blobs). The WestBed traversal is fixed. The front-edge slope wedges are hidden by clipped hedgerows. The arrival hedge gap matches East Field's hedge tunnel. No module work is needed.

issues.issue: Trail exits are coplanar with plinth caps, which causes z-fighting or shadow acne on the main road. Where the portal sits on bare plinth grass (no in-map path ribbon on top), the trail top and the cap are likely the same plane. Visible at the Amherst east00 -> 1020000 west00 main road: a dark, grainy grey parallelogram around the 1020000 west00 portal (FieldEastOfAmherst_1020000_Overview px ~600-720 x 360-413). Also at Townstreet west00: fine vertical striping beside the sand apron (AmherstTownstreet_1010002_Overview px ~350-435 x 750-785).

verdicts.strengths: Technically much healthier than iter1. All 25 maps build with no errors and pass their per-map traversal checks. All 24 portal links are reciprocal. There are 0 hidden objects besides the tagged colliders, 0 generic names, 0 missing materials, 0 broken instances and 0 floating props out of 3,700 checked. Every map is under the 400k triangle budget and the WORLD layer is at 2.87M of its 3.5M budget. The build is deterministic (seeded RNG) and takes 38 s. Trails are now solid causeways and stair flights, not wedges. No map module imports another. What still needs work: z-fighting where trails meet maps, faceted clouds, route connectivity that nothing checks, and the hidden Tomato Field trail being built as stone stairs.
Clean flights and paths. The only finding is BluffLadder, which sits 1.1 m from Main with no route joining them (flat ground).
No technical findings: routes are clean and the trail joins without steps. It has fewer houses than in iter1, but that was a triage decision, not a defect.
Routes and the door arch are fine. The one real fix is a small bush standing on the sky-islet perch.
The interior is coherent and the loft ladder route works. The dining set crowds the ToStove route.
The descent trail is now a stone flight with landings instead of a 12 m wedge. A mushroom cluster sits at the end of the WestIslets route.
Traversal passes. However, the AroundKnoll and WestLadders routes are not joined to Main, and a straight-line check from each finds a real step.
Arch Rock reads well. The whole upper route network connects to Main only through one 1.2 m gap that no route covers (flat ground).
The iter1 traversal failure (vine feet) is fixed and descend_only vines are used. The East_Ground and T12 route groups are not joined to the main route chain.
The mesa birch landmark is restored and the three portals are reached. Maria_Ladder77 sits 4.1 m from the main route with no route joining them (flat ground).
The ship now hangs off the island edge and the quay is the cliff. Its 26 route checks pass. The Knoll and ToLedgeRopes routes are not joined to the rest, and ToLedgeRopes starts 1.1 m below Main.
The blue-and-white retheme separates it from the Weapon Store, it uses real walkable crate lids, and the room fills the frame. One helmet pile and one crate need a small move.

The in00 blocker is fixed and all 8 portals are reached. No route joins the main road to the back portals (to 1000001, 1000005, 1000006 and 1000002). The 3.6 m gap between them is flat, but nothing verifies it.
The giant white trunk landmark is restored and traversal passes. No technical findings.
The dark forest identity lands. It still relies on module-local material swaps that use a private materials API, and on a recoloured copy of the kit rope.
The trail no longer runs into the door dome. It still uses its own copy of hemp_rope instead of the kit rope.

The traversal failure is fixed. The two trellises flagged near routes are false positives (they stand behind the ropes). The Summit route needs joining to the rest (1.9 m, flat). It also has a duplicate hemp_rope.
The broken-up branches and the jump tower work. However, 15 of its 16 routes connect to the portal route only through a 2 m gap that no route covers (flat ground).
The lower forest floor (dell) adds structure and the hub reaches the portal. Only minor route-joining remains (T22/CentreDell near-miss).
The in01 blocker is gone and all 5 portals are reached. The Lookout route sits 5.5 m from the other routes with no route joining them.
Uses m.collider in place of hide_render proxies. All its near-route flags are acceptable or false positives (the eaves above the beam route).
The west door arch fixes the blocked Main route. No technical findings.
The spiral jar shelf and the one-way beam drop are validated. On the LeftStack perch route the character walks through the potion rows.
Arrival on the high rim road works. The basin's vine routes stop 1.7 m short of MidRow. The arrival trail is 82 m long (see the layout issue).
The hedge tunnel and grassy hop ramps pass traversal. The berry bushes flagged near routes are acceptable (0.8 m clearance).
The WestBed traversal failure is fixed and the trellis canopy route works. The props flagged near routes are acceptable.

issues.issue: Where each trail meets a map, the trail surface lies in the same plane as the map ground. trails.build_trail starts the solid at p0 = portal - 1.2*na, at exactly a.z, and runs flat out to p1 (up to 3.5 m outside the map). Meanwhile map terrain runs to, and about 1 m past, the footprint edge. I raycast the built .blend (read-only), comparing the trail surface with each map's _Terrain. At 25 of 40 trail ends the trail top is within 3 mm of the map terrain over about 2.5-3.7 m along the portal normal. This is a lower bound, because plinth caps were not tested. At some ends the trail apron stands above the map surface: 1020000 west00 0.63 m, 1000000 in05 0.49, 1000006 out00 0.41, 1000000 in00 0.38, 1020000 in00 0.36, 40000 in00 0.32. In the renders this shows as EEVEE z-fight stripes and hard-edged pale rectangles at the portals: MushroomTown_20000_Overview at the 30000 in00 ring (about 1440,980); Region_AmherstArea at Amherst east00 (about 1020,700); Region_WestAmherstForests at 1000000 in02/in03 and Amherst west00. There is also an abrupt colour change where the pale M_Main_Road meets the in-map M_Path_Dirt. Iter1 shared fix #4 asked for exactly this and it did not land.
issues.fix: In trails.build_trail, raycast the map ground (map terrain plus plinth caps, i.e. both maps' MapCtx ground objects) for every trail row. Wherever a map surface is within ±0.05 m of the trail top, or above it, sink that row 0.03-0.05 m below the map surface or clip the solid there, so the map surface always wins. Start the trail solid at the footprint edge. From the portal to the edge, lay a geo.path_ribbon in the trail's top material over the map ground (lifted 0.02-0.03 m, with end_taper) so the road visibly carries into the map. Re-run the junction probe until it finds 0 coplanar samples and no apron more than 0.05 m above map ground.

issues.issue: The 'all 25 maps pass traversal' result overstates what is verified. Traversal proves each declared route fragment is walkable and that some route touches each portal, but nothing proves the fragments connect into one graph. I joined routes whose endpoints come within 1.0 m of another route, and also joined any two routes passing within 2.2 m of the same ladder or rope. That still leaves route groups with no portal in 14 maps. In 1000000, no declared route links the main-road group (west00/east00/in02/in03) to the back group (in00/in04/in05/in01, which leads to 4 sub-maps). In 1000005, 15 of 16 routes are cut off from the out00 route. I walked each gap in the .blend. The important ones are flat, walkable ground (max step 0.07 m or less), so the connections exist but are not declared. Three gaps hit real steps, though: 40000 AroundKnoll 0.53 m, 40000 WestLadders 1.35 m, and 60000 ToLedgeRopes 1.11 m. Those need a declared connector, or the platforms are unreachable.
issues.fix: Add a route-graph check to traversal.check_map. Nodes are route vertices. Join two routes when a vertex of one is within 0.75 m (xy) and 0.45 m (z, via ground_z) of a segment of the other. A ladder or rope climb only counts as a link if a route actually walks it. Report every group of routes that contains no portal as 'orphan_routes' (medium), and fail the map if its portals are not all in one group. Write the groups to build_report so fixers can see them, then stitch the routes per map (see the map issues below).

issues.issue: No walk between maps is validated. Per-map traversal runs before world.trails() exists, and validate.py only reads build_report. scripts/build_map.py, which is what map fixers run, never builds trails or the island ground. So trail stair flights, landings, rails and the steps where trails meet maps are invisible to every check, which is why the junction defect above went unnoticed. The floating-props check also skips the WORLD collections (trail rails, hedges, signs). My probe found no step over 0.45 m on the centre line where trails meet maps today, but nothing would catch a regression.
issues.fix: After world.trails() in build.build, walk each trail from portal to portal: start at the last route point near portal A, follow p0..p3, and end at the first route point near portal B. Use a GroundIndex made of both maps' ground plus World_Trails and the plinth caps, and reuse the traversal.check_route logic. Store ok/issues per trail in build_report.trails, and make validate.py's traversal check fail on errors. Add WORLD/World_Trails instances to the floating-props test.

issues.issue: Clouds now look faceted. After iter1 performance fix #18, the cloud puffs in kit/terrain._cloud use icosphere subdiv=1 (80 faces each), but the instances are scaled 6-30x (Cloud_SeaLayer 16-30, Cloud_CliffBase 6-13, Cloud_High 6-11, Cloud_PeakRing 2.2). In Island_Overview, Island_Hero, Region_SouthperryAndSplitRoad (bottom left) and Region_AmherstArea (the peak halos), the cloud sea, the clouds at the cliff base and the peak halos read as flat-shaded white boulders. In iter1 they were smooth puffs.
issues.fix: In _cloud, use subdiv=2 for the puffs and subdiv=3 for the core, and build with smooth=True, sharp_angle=180 so normals are not split. Keep 5-7 puffs. Budget: about +2.5k triangles per cloud instance, and there are about 120 cloud instances, so roughly +300-350k triangles. That fits in the WORLD headroom (2.87M used of 3.5M), so this deliberately reverses the cloud part of iter1 #18.

issues.issue: The classic hidden Tomato Field link (HIDDEN_TRAILS, 1020000 in00 to 1020001 out00) is built as grey stone stair flights with stone landings. Its 7.4 m drop over 23 m is 24.9°, above MAX_RAMP_DEG (20°), so _profile() switches to M_StoneWall flights even though hidden=True. Region_AmherstArea (about 1400-1560, 820-880) shows a cobbled staircase between two hedge rows. It is the most path-like trail on the island, the opposite of hidden.
issues.fix: In build_trail, for hidden trails either allow a grass ramp up to about 27° (M_Grass top, flanks as now), or build turf steps (stairs with mat=M_Grass and side_mat=M_Dirt_Cliff, no stone landing slabs). Alternatively, raise 1020001's base z from 2.0 to about 4.5 so the drop is 20° or less. Keep the hedge screens and the lack of signposts.

issues.issue: layout.resolve() silently lengthens a link's gap until the map footprints stop overlapping, up to gap+60 m, with no warning. Results: 1000000 in04 to 1000005 went from 12 to 58 m; 1010002 west00 to 1010004 east00 from 40 to 76 m (an 82 m trail with 12.1 m rise); 1000004 from 38 to 42 m. The 1000006 link is authored at 64 m. trails.py draws each one as a straight p1-to-p2 causeway with no waypoints, so the classic 'portal at the back of the field' becomes a 58-82 m empty corridor. See the long vertical dirt strips in Region_WestAmherstForests (x about 760 and 1160) and Region_AmherstArea (x about 780-830).
issues.fix: Technical part: have resolve() record a LAYOUT_WARN in build_report when the final gap exceeds 1.5x the authored gap or grows by more than 10 m. Let build_trail bend trails longer than 30 m through 1-2 waypoints along plinth edges, and add a midway rest spot or sign. Whether to move 1000005, 1000006 and 1010004 closer (smaller D or a different bearing) is a design decision for the lead, not a technical fix.

issues.issue: The props_near_routes check and the route-blocked test raise false alarms in some places and miss things in others. (a) BODY_Z tops out at 1.6 m, above PLAYER_HEIGHT (1.5 m). As a result, the eave wall plate in the shop interiors (at SHOP_H 6.6, over a beam route at 5.0) is flagged 4 times across 60001 and 1010001. (b) Props standing behind a ladder or rope on a climb segment are flagged (the 1000004 trellises). (c) Whether a prop blocks is still decided by words in its name (_PASSABLE_WORDS: sign, lantern, flag, banner, portal, vine), in both traversal.py and validate.py. Any solid object with those words in its name is invisible to the checks; for example, X1010004_Vine_Arch is passable only because of its name. Iter1 #16 asked for a registry 'passable' tag instead. (d) The blocked test still casts one ray on the route centre line, and props_near_routes only checks collection instances. Meshes a map builds directly in _Architecture next to a route are never checked. (e) check_map swallows exceptions from obstacle_bvh: if it fails, obstacles becomes None and blocking checks are silently skipped. MapCtx.ramp likewise swallows errors when building blend ribbons. (f) m.route(z_from=...) is used to draw the debug ribbon but is not stored, so check_route always validates the topmost surface, even under bridges or overhangs.
issues.fix: Set BODY_Z = (0.15, PLAYER_HEIGHT). Skip props whose nearest route segment is a climb within CLIMB_RADIUS of a ladder or rope. Add a 'passable' tag to the @asset definitions of ropes, vines, signs, banners and flowers, and drop the word list. Cast 3 rays (offsets 0 and ±0.6 m) in check_route. Include non-instance _Architecture meshes in props_near_routes. Record obstacle and blend-ribbon exceptions in build_report instead of passing silently. Store z_from on each route and use it in check_route. Grade near-route hits by body clearance: medium below 0.45 m, low otherwise. With these changes the check reports only the 2 real outdoor problems and a few interior nudges.

issues.issue: Several local copies and workarounds that iter1 #11, #13, #14 and #16 asked to remove are still present. hemp_rope() is duplicated verbatim in m1000003 and m1000004, giving those maps a different rope look from the kit rope every other map uses. m1000002._vine copies the kit rope mesh and swaps its materials instead of calling m.ladder(kind='vine'). m1000002 (_darken_terrain/_swap_mat) and m1000005 (_swap_grass) recolour terrain after building, using the private materials API (M._MatBuilder, M._bw), because TERRAIN_STYLES has no moss or dark-grass style. The climb_route() workaround remains in 40001, 40002 and 60000, and _check_climb in 1000002 and 1000006. kit/interior.crate_block still hides a collision box with hide_render and no collider tag, so it would fail no_hidden_objects if a map used it. mapkit.ladder adds two loose vertices so that traversal can read the climb position from the bounding-box centre.
issues.fix: Add a TERRAIN_STYLES entry 'grass_moss' (mossy cap material, dark soil sides) and switch 1000002 and 1000005 to style='grass_moss'. Replace hemp_rope with m.ladder(kind='rope') in 1000003 and 1000004, and _vine with m.ladder(kind='vine') in 1000002. Once the climb-aware validator is confirmed to handle routes through climbs, delete climb_route and _check_climb. Make crate_block use m.collider. Store obj['climb_xy'] in m.ladder, read it in traversal.climbables, and remove the loose vertices.

verdicts.strengths: Clear landmarks: the big yellow mushroom house with a barrel-chimney lid, and Roger in his hedge-walled, fenced vegetable-garden terrace above the street. Warm, coherent props (lamps, benches, red mailbox, planters, crop beds) and a readable dirt street with a branch to the door. Weaknesses: no player proxy in frame (the player is at local (15.5,13.5), about 16 m from GAMEPLAY_FOCUS (28,23)). The bottom-left third of the frame is empty lawn and path, and the sunflower arrival meadow is out of frame.

The strongest town gameplay shot. A cobble hill town on three readable levels: a stone-walled plateau with ladder and rope, a red spotted tower, yellow mushroom houses, the green-cap potion shop with a door chevron, and a rainbow sculpture on the square. Several NPC proxies plus the player are in frame, so scale reads well. Reads as Amherst. Small flaws: cobble ribbons end in hard rectangular notches against grass (upper path near image x 940-1000, y 400; the rectangular cobble patch at x 880-1000, y 440-570). Cobbles are chunky.

The most recognizable map on the island: whitewashed blue-domed houses, the striped lighthouse, the grand white staircase to the quay, market stalls, palms, and the three-masted ship moored at the island cliff (iter1 had it landlocked). Weaknesses: the Gameplay frame shows no characters at all (the player is at (26,11), about 34 m from focus (60,16), and Shanks is screened by the masts per wave1 notes). The ship's sails fill the bottom third and hide the quay and gangway.

A distinctive composition: the classic lambda arch is rebuilt as a 3D arc of stone stepping drums over a real stone arch void, set between deep terraced ravines with autumn birches. It reads as different from 40000 and 40002. Weaknesses: the snail and blue snail proxies are about 25-30 px at GAMEPLAY_SCALE 40 and nearly unreadable. The rope climbables (image approx (460,480), (270,600), (905,930)) read as bent shepherd's-crook posts rather than ropes. Large flat grass expanses carry little dressing.

Clearly the dangerous pocket: dark blue-green moss, a wet dark soil cliff curtained with leafy climbing vines, gloomy pines, brambles, purple and blue toadstools, and readable Orange Mushroom proxies. The player stands next to the arrival portal, so scale is established. It looks unlike the bright fields.
